original.target_description: Study 1, ordinal knowledge ascription, Standard True Belief versus Gettier cases, GEE follow-up contrast.

n.sample_role: Participants included in the Standard True Belief versus Gettier knowledge-ascription GEE comparison; repeated vignette responses are not counted as independent participants.
n.exclusions: Methods §2.1: 238 recruited; 16 incomplete and 14 too-fast survey respondents removed, leaving 208. §2.2.1 additionally skips cases failing comprehension and skips knowledge questions following belief denial. The target GEE explicitly prints N=202; the precise additional participant-level exclusion breakdown from 208 to 202 is not provided in the inspected Results. No N inferred from df or response-frequency totals.
n.location: In-press p.6, §3.2 Knowledge ascription scores, contrast (2); canonical L481–505, especially L498–499
n.quote: (2) Standard True Belief versus Gettier Cases (v2 = 107.81, ... df = 1, N = 202, p < .001, B = 1.62, Exp(B) = 5.07)

replication.target_description: Ordinal knowledge ascription, Standard True Belief versus Gettier cases, GEE target contrast.

n.exclusions: 86 recruited; 23 excluded for not completing the survey.

reported_success.quote: We succeeded in replicating the main effect, as well as all significant differences between story types for knowledge ascription that the authors obtained in the original study.

notes:
Primary project table independently identifies the same target GEE test (row Nagel et al. (2013), ReplicationANALYSIS). Its B = 0.42 differs from the target-contrast B = 1.32 in the primary replication report; 0.42 belongs to Skeptical Pressure versus Gettier in that report. Test statistic and p extracted from the matched report; no coefficient substituted.
Completion source review (n_o): The explicitly identified contrast directly prints analytic participant N=202. Recruitment and case-level screening are distinguished from this model N.
Completion source review (es_value_o): The described knowledge-ascription Standard True Belief versus Gettier GEE contrast directly prints v2=107.81, df=1; preserve canonical metric glyph rendering.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): The same GEE contrast directly prints p < .001; the strict upper bound is preserved.
